verdict.rationale: Rootly documents templates/multiple retrospective processes routed by severity (rootly-docs-14), auto-drafted sections (Summary, Impact, Root Cause, Mitigation, Resolution, Curated Timeline) from timeline/Slack/transcripts (rootly-docs-13, rootly-docs-27, rootly-docs-54), a collaborative rich-text editor for review (rootly-docs-15, rootly-docs-28, rootly-docs-51), and an authoritative incident timeline feeding drafts (rootly-docs-12, rootly-docs-40, rootly-docs-50). Publication/sign-off flow specifics and independent hands-on validation of the postmortem workflow are thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the review-to-publication step, and more detail on approval/sign-off mechanics.
